independent_geoid_diagnostic.interpolation: Bilinear at pixel centers; no fitted or selected offsets.
independent_geoid_diagnostic.hypothesis: h_ellipsoid = H_orthometric + N_EGM96; not a proven Roy datum.
independent_geoid_diagnostic.source: Local PROJ egm96_15.gtx, 15 arc-minute geoid undulation grid.

limitations: Four train patches, 100 positions: not an audit of every Roy topographic pixel.
Correlation or lowest RMSE does not identify an exact DEM product.
Fixed EGM96 shift tests a datum hypothesis; it does not prove the original datum.
Native-grid GEE slope need not equal slope computed on another grid before export.
Original private COG, interpolation chain and vertical datum remain unverified.
